text: And this is the thing{H1697} that thou shalt do{H6213} unto them to hallow{H6942} them, to minister unto me in the priest's office:{H3547} take{H3947} one{H259} young{H1121} bullock{H6499} and two{H8147} rams{H352} without blemish,{H8549}
